message: 黒い悪魔と白い司書
Sally and Eauderourke ended up getting jobs at a beef bowl restaurant. I don't think there's any problem, but I should probably report it to Helena, the commander of the Crusaders.
I visit the old school building and knock on the door to the chairwoman's office.

name: Helena
message: 「If I want to see something, I want to see it, so it can't be helped!」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you want to see it that badly, then I'll show it to you!」

name: Synn
message: 「...What's going on?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn, let's get in on this too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!?」
Shoved forward by Paqy, I go tumbling into the chairwoman's office.

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura?」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, welcome\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey, don't you think so too, Synn? That you'd love to see the secret archive hidden beneath the library?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Which is why I am always telling you to submit an application to me if you wish to view it, am I not?」

name: Melilot
message: 「If I judge your reason to be valid, I will lend you the key to the basement.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Tch.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why do you look so disappointed, Paqy?」

name: Melilot
message: 「*Sigh*... Surely you at least know the library's regulations, Helena?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please do not make me, known by the epithet of the Immovable Grand Library, explain them every single time.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's the first time I've ever heard that nickname! Aren't you just a homebody, Melilot?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You may evaluate me however you wish. Just please do not disturb the blissful time I spend immersed in reading.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu. I want some supreme happiness too.」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot... won't you read this book aloud for me in that clear voice of yours? Please soothe this body of mine, exhausted from my grueling duties as chairwoman.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena...」

name: Melilot
message: 「G-Geez... If that was all you wanted, you could have just said so from the beginning.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd like to listen too.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Go right ahead. Ahem...! Now then, I shall begin reading.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Genzo's gnarled, rough hands coarsely caressed Shizuko's inner thighs. 'Ah!? M-Mmm,' Shizuko--」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Melilot-san!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「H-Hey...! What is this book!? I can't read any more of this!」

name: Helena
message: 「No way, no way, you said you'd read it to me!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I made no such promise!」

name: Helena
message: 「What's your deal? At your big age, you're telling me you can't even read a romance novel like this out loud?」

name: Melilot
message: 「H-Hmph... Age has nothing to do with feeling embarrassed.」

name: Helena
message: 「That's why people call you precocious, you know」

name: Melilot
message: 「F-Fine, I understand. If you're going to go that far, I shall read it all the way to the end!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Good for you, Synn-chan!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thump-thump... Hey, don't pass this to me!!」
And so began Melilot's reading session.
Ms. Helena wore a devilish smile the entire time.
